Year introduced: 2024

Capacity: 128 GB, 256 GB, 512 GB

Colors: Black, White, Pink, Teal, Ultramarine

Model numbers: A3081 (United States, Puerto Rico), A3286, (Bahrain, Canada, Iraq, Guam, Japan, Jordan, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, U.S. Virgin Islands), A3288 (China mainland, Hong Kong, Macao), A3287 (other countries and regions)

Details: iPhone 16 has a 6.1-inch all-screen Super Retina XDR display with the Dynamic Island. The back is textured matte glass, and there's a contoured-edge anodized aluminum band around the frame. The Action button is on the upper left side, and the side button is on the right side of the device. The Camera Control is on the lower right side. There are two cameras on the back, aligned vertically: Ultra Wide and Fusion. In the United States, there's no SIM tray. In other countries or regions, there's a SIM tray on the left side that holds a physical nano-SIM card. On the bottom there's a USB-C connector for charging and transferring data.
